messages.subject: Calderdale House — seller's price increase to £8.45m
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Frances,

The seller has increased the price to £8,450,000 (from £8.3m). Given the Harlow Reed review is now settled at £286,000, the revised price still reflects a net initial yield of about 6.9%, which we consider defensible. Sarah and I recommend accepting the price subject to us tidying the service-charge balancing and VAT mechanics in your favour.

Please confirm and we'll send our response draft.

Best,
Elena

—
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Alistair,

Our client accepts the price of £8,450,000. We attach our response draft. We've accepted the VAT amendment subject to capping the interest at the Contract Rate, and amended the service-charge balancing clause: 30 working days for the balancing adjustment and a managing-agent-certified reconciliation of expenditure to completion. Subject to those we are agreed and can aim to exchange on Friday 7 March.

Kind regards,
Elena

—
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
